explanation: This message appears to be a standard delivery notification from a recognised courier service. No scam indicators were detected by our rule engine, ML classifier, or threat-intelligence feeds. The language, formatting, and phone number are consistent with legitimate delivery updates.
next_steps: If you are expecting a delivery, you can follow up using the tracking number provided.
If you did NOT order anything, verify by contacting the courier service using their official website or customer care number.
Never share OTP or payment details with a delivery agent.

citations.title: Cyber Security Awareness for Citizens
citations.snippet: Always verify delivery notifications through official courier tracking websites rather than clicking links in messages.

limitations: This analysis is automated. A low-risk result means no scam patterns were detected — it does not guarantee the message is genuine. Always verify important communications independently.
